title: Stage 10 — AI-assisted coding
description: Assistants and app builders with judgment.

questions.prompt: The safest loop with a coding assistant is:
choices: Spec/tests first, then implement, then read the diff and run tests

questions.prompt: A common silent ML bug assistants introduce:
choices: Scaling or encoding on train+test together

questions.prompt: Untrusted pickle or SQL concatenated from a prompt is:
questions.explanation: Generated code can drop secrets and inject SQL.

questions.prompt: App builders that scaffold whole apps still need:
choices: Auth, secrets, and failure-mode checks by you, the owner
questions.explanation: You ship it; you own it.

questions.prompt: If you cannot explain a generated line:
choices: It does not ship until you can
Boilerplate and translating a precise spec
questions.explanation: They do not know your warehouse.

questions.prompt: Using an assistant on the capstone is:
choices: Allowed if tests pass and the executive summary is yours to defend

questions.prompt: Time-series shuffled CV in generated notebooks is:
choices: A leakage smell you must catch

questions.prompt: A good thing to ask the assistant after a first draft:
choices: “Where could this leak the target or leak the test set?”

questions.prompt: Copying generated analysis you do not understand into a portfolio is:
choices: Misrepresentation; this is a study repo
questions.explanation: Interviewers notice in a few questions.

questions.prompt: Lockfiles and dependency review matter for generated apps because:
choices: Supply-chain and version drift are real
questions.explanation: Do not pip install mystery extras.

questions.prompt: The assistant's explanation of a p-value is:
When generated code uses iterrows on a large frame:
choices: Replace with vectorized/groupby as in Stage 04

questions.prompt: Secrets in .env committed by a builder:
choices: Must be gitignored and rotated if leaked
questions.explanation: This repo gitignores .env patterns via common sense; never commit keys.

questions.prompt: “Vibe coding” on the official roadmap is:
choices: Using AI coding assistants and app builders as a professional skill
questions.explanation: It comes last because judgment requires Stages 1–9.

questions.prompt: A passing pytest suite after generation means:
choices: The product is fair and causal
The specified tests passed — not that the spec was complete
questions.explanation: Tests are only as good as the invariants you wrote.
